page.layout: One page of text: a verse epigraph at the top (centred, italic lines), then a heading "IACOBI" at right, then a woodcut ornament below. No margin notes.
page.notes: The woodcut ornament (a cherub's head between two cornucopiae with foliage and pendant tassels) is not transcribed as text. The verse lines are printed with long s and f forms; transcribed here with plain s. "Beza" and "Valet" are as printed; "Vegetaque" and "Viuit" likewise. Line 5 "quicis" is as printed and may be a misprint for "quibus"; not certain.
